title: Voice dataset manifest line
description: One line of a NeMo-style JSONL manifest for speech data. audio_filepath, duration and text are the fields NeMo speech recipes read; the other fields carry speaker, split, integrity and consent references.

audio_filepath.description: Path of the audio file, relative to the dataset root or an object key relative to the release prefix.

duration.description: Audio duration in seconds. It must match the duration in the audio header.

speaker.description: Pseudonymous speaker id. It never carries a name.

consent_id.description: Id of the consent and license record that covers this clip.
